facts.business: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company focused on consumer electronics, lighting, wearables, hearables, AC-PCBs, display and camera modules, and backward integration through joint ventures and ODM capabilities.

segments.name: Consumer Electronics (LED TV, Refrigerators, Washing Machines, etc.)

capacity_or_capex.timeline: facility construction completed, machinery installation underway, mass production to start during 2026-27

capacity_or_capex.item: AC-PCB new manufacturing facility in Chennai
capacity_or_capex.timeline: being established to support increased customer requirements

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant and equipment and intangible assets

guidance_or_targets.statement: Global electronics market projected to reach US$ 4.4-4.5 Trillion by CY 2035
India's real GDP estimated to have expanded by 7.7% in 2025-26
Refrigerator annual capacity increased from ~1.2 Million to 2 Million units

auditor.name: S N Dhawan & CO LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: There has been no qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer given by the Auditors in their Report.

key_risks: Geopolitical developments and volatile energy prices
Potential disruptions to global trade and supply chains
Imported inflation and global trade uncertainty
Transition to revised BEE and energy-efficiency norms temporarily affecting procurement and inventory patterns
Supply chain complexities and evolving regulatory landscape in electronics industry
facts.related_party_note: The company has joint ventures including 50:50 JV with Signify for Lighting, 50:50 JV with Imagine Marketing for Wearables & Hearables, and Rexxam-Dixon JV for AC-PCB. Loan given/repayment transactions with related parties noted in cash flow statement.
